entries.notes:
A word diff against HEAD shows exactly the corrected text, and nothing else changed on these lines. The trailing spaces of l.229 and l.275 are intact.
- l.229, Definition 3.1: '+a' gives 'Let $\Statespace$ be a Riemannian manifold'.
- l.266: 'follow:' -> 'follows:', 'forms' -> 'form' (the subject is 'theoretical advancements', plural) and '+for' gives 'used for IL training'.
- l.275: 'flow family' -> 'flows' gives 'a family of generative flows is'.
- l.276: '$(\foutstar,\ForwardPolicyStar)$' -> '$(\ForwardPolicyStar,\foutstar)$', character for character the corrected text.

Meaning is unchanged. The first three are grammar. The pair order is notation only, and it now agrees with three things:
- the paper's own definition, l.165: 'a generative flow ... is the data of a star forward policy ... and a star outflow';
- the Lean structure EGF.GenerativeFlow (Defs.lean:123), whose fields are `policy` then `outflow`;
- EGF.IsUniversalFamilyEps (UniversalFamily.lean:84), which bounds initialError/terminalError of (F.policy, F.outflow) for some F in the family.
Definition 3.2 and IsUniversalFamilyEps still state the same thing: probability measures mu, nu << lambda with bounded density, every eps > 0, and a flow in the family from nu to mu with the error sum below eps. The batch changes no hypothesis and no conclusion.

The f_out (density) versus Lean outflow (measure) reading is as C-18 left it. It is not this batch's.

The finding's claim that l.251 is 'the only place where the pair is written outflow first' is wrong. v1 l.192 (v2 l.202) also writes it outflow first. See finding 1.

l.1315 and l.1418: 'depths and width' -> 'depths and widths'. The three sibling main captions (star, 4 circles and two spirals, the last at l.1527 from C-45) now open identically. Both figures vary two widths, 32 and 64, so the plural is true of them.

l.1522: '2' -> 'two', giving 'Generation of two spirals'. This matches subfigure a's subcaption (l.1476, C-44), so the figure names its dataset one way. The rest of the subcaption (2x64 to 3x64, then 4x128 and 5x128, top; 6x64 to 9x64, bottom; C-37) is untouched.

No other character changed. In the aux, the caption fields of fig:size_star and fig:size_circles changed; their numbers (8, 9) and pages (19, 20) did not. No v2 line still says 'depths and width ' or '2 spirals'. The commented-out l.1217 already says 'widths'.

answers_to_master.edits_exact: Yes. Each of the nine edits is its entry's corrected text, character for character; the only exception is C-61's l.851 keeping v1's space in '$Y\subset \Statespace$', which is invisible in math mode. None changes meaning. C-61's 'with $\widehat\lambda=\lambda$' (l.741) is exactly the hypothesis of C-21's remark (l.886) and of EGF.mixingCoeff_self_add_le / EGF.tsum_mixingCoeff_self_ne_top_iff (finite lambda, lam.bind pi = lam, mixingCoeff pi lam lam). Given lambda invariant it is equivalent to the old wording through the Lean chain C-61 names, so it adds no hypothesis. C-60's pair (pi*, f_out*) at l.276 has the field order of EGF.GenerativeFlow (policy, outflow) used by EGF.IsUniversalFamilyEps, and the order of l.165's definition.
answers_to_master.markers: All nine are placed correctly. l.236 and l.279 are inside their definition environments, before \end{definition}. l.859 is in the proof, before \end{proof}. l.1322 and l.1425 are after the \label, and l.1524 is after the closed subcaption. None is inside a definition sentence, a display or a \caption{...}, and none splits a paragraph.

findings.what:
Optional precision, in C-61's own terms. Two sentences still state the remark's hypothesis without 'with lambda-hat = lambda', while l.741 now includes it:
- l.872 (C-29's text before Theorem B.1): 'When $\lambda$ itself is invariant, summable $L^2$-mixing (Definition 3.3) gives the outflow as a convergent series (see the remark after the proof)';
